verses.text: The Spirit clearly says that in later times some will abandon the faith and follow deceptive spirits and teachings from demons.
These teachings come through hypocritical liars whose consciences have been burned as with a hot iron.
They forbid marriage and demand that people avoid certain foods, even though God created these foods to be received with thanks by those who believe and know the truth.
Everything God created is good, and nothing should be rejected if it is received with thanks,
because it is made holy through God's word and prayer.
If you explain these things to the brothers and sisters, you'll be a good servant of Christ Jesus, nourished by the words of faith and the sound teaching you've followed.
Reject irreverent old wives' tales. Instead, train yourself in godliness.
Physical training has some value, but godliness is valuable in every way, holding promise for both this life and the life to come.
This saying is trustworthy and deserves full acceptance.
That's why we work hard and struggle: we've put our hope in the living God, who is the Savior of all people, especially of those who believe.
Don't let anyone look down on you because you're young. Be an example to the believers in what you say and do, in love, faith, and purity.
Until I come, focus on the public reading of Scripture, encouragement, and teaching.
Don't neglect the gift you have, which was given to you through prophecy when the elders laid their hands on you.
Practice these things and give yourself fully to them, so everyone can see your progress.
Pay close attention to your life and your teaching. Keep at it, because by doing so you'll save both yourself and those who hear you.
